metadata.name: AddInventory
metadata.description: Use this API to Create/Update/Approve/Reject Inventory based on decision flag.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: BranchCode
request_fields.description: Code assigned to branch from where the card was issued. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example:1006 Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758 Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: Client Id Valid Values: 1422245 Format:XXXXX Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingMode
request_fields.description: Shipping Method to send cards valid values 0=Standard 1=Priority 2=Overnight Example : 0 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AcctYesNo
request_fields.description: whether Account number should be printed  in embossing file or not. Valid Values : 1 ,2 1= YES 2= NO Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: Title
request_fields.description: Title for the customer Valid Values:  Refer Appendix Section : Title Values Example: Mr. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Cardholder First Name Valid Values:  A-Z, a-z and all special characters Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Middle Name Valid Values:  A-Z, a-z and all special characters Example: Charles Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid Values:  A-Z, a-z and all special characters Example: Hudson Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid Values:  A-Z, a-z and all special characters Example: Hudson M Charles Allowable Values: 28

request_fields.name: EmbossingLine4
request_fields.description: Text to be print on Line 4 of a plastic. Valid Values:a-z, A-Z Allowable Values: 26

request_fields.name: Addressline1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Addressline2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: ZIPCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Value Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes(US) Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: UserID
request_fields.description: User id of the user performing the activity. Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9. Example : Sam Allowable Values: 128

request_fields.name: FICompanyName
request_fields.description: Company name Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Allowable Values: 26

request_fields.name: OrderId
request_fields.description: Order number for an inventory. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 3478 Condition:  Mandatory When decision flag = 2,3, 4

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Flag to decides which operation needs to be performed. Valid Values: 1 = creating an inventory 2 = updating an inventory 3 = Approving an inventory 4 = Rejecting an inventory Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: PlasticCode
request_fields.description: Plastic Code Valid values:0-9 Example: 32 Condition  "Mandatory when decision flag is 1. Optional when decision flag is 2". Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: LogoID
request_fields.description: Logo ID printed on the cards. Valid value:  0-9, A-Z Example : Cash187 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: NumberOfCards
request_fields.description: Total number of cards. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 17 Condition : Mandatory when decision flag is 1 Note : Maximum allowed limit is 5000 , can be decreased by program manager

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: OrderID
children.description: Order number for an inventory. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 3478

children.name: RequestID
children.description: Unique Id of the cards which are created from Inventory Valid values : 0-9 Example : 3478
